item.title: Victim’s Mother, Brother Speak Ahead of Killer Father’s Sentencing
item.description: Hope 'Onyx' Cornish's mother and brother present victim impact statements in Delbert Cornish's sentencing. Cornish pleaded guilty to the murder of Onyx. In a tearful courtroom confession, Delbert told the judge, 'I pulled the trigger. I shot my daughter.' (1/28/26)

item.title: Delbert Cornish: ‘Regret, Anguish and Remorse… For What I’ve Done’
item.description: Delbert Cornish speaks before being sentenced for the murder of his daughter, Hope 'Onyx' Cornish. Delbert said 'I could never muster enough words to convey the amount of regret, anguish and remorse I have for what I've done. (1/28/26)

item.title: Delbert Cornish Sentenced for Daughter’s Murder
item.description: Delbert Cornish is sentenced for the first-degree murder of his daughter, Hope 'Onyx' Cornish. In November Delbert pleaded guilty to killing Onyx. (1/28/26)

item.title: ‘Kevin Chose Murder’: Prosecutors Urge Jury to Convict Kevin Ellis
item.description: Prosecutors urged the jury to convict Kevin Ellis of murder, saying he was a key part of the plan to murder Matthew Restelli. (1/28/26)

item.title: Kevin Ellis’ Defense: Kevin ‘Had No Idea’ There Was a Plot to Kill
item.description: Kevin Ellis' attorney told the jury that his client was not involved in the plot to kill Matthew Restelli and fired the deadly shots in self-defense. (1/28/26)

item.title: Prosecution Points To Knife, Coverup As Proof In Kevin Ellis Murder Trial
item.description: Prosecutors said Kevin Ellis was an active participant in the plot to kill Matthew Restelli as well as the coverup after his death. (1/28/26)

item.title: Idaho Father Apologizes for Daughter’s Murder, Is Sentenced
item.description: Idaho father Delbert Cornish is sentenced for his daughter Hope 'Onyx' Cornish's murder. Delbert pleaded guilty to the first-degree murder of Onyx. (1/28/26)

item.title: Victim’s Daughter Addresses Susan Embert at Sentencing: ‘I Hate You’
item.description: Rachel Embert had harsh words for Susan Embert, who was convicted of murdering Rachel's father, Jake, who was shot to death in 2014. (1/28/26)

item.title: NY seeks July trial for Luigi Mangione’s state case as federal trial looms in fall
item.description: NEW YORK (AP) — Manhattan prosecutors urged a judge on Wednesday to set a July trial date in Luigi Mangione’s state murder case in the killing of UnitedHealthcare CEO Brian Thompson, two months before jury selection is set to begin in his federal death penalty case. item.title: Brendan Banfield Says He ‘Didn’t Stop’ Au Pair Advances
item.description: On the stand, Brendan Banfield describes how texting, dating apps and a late-night conversation led to an affair with the family au pair. (1/28/26)
